notes: Driving the CC201 free-roam with no objectives is Simulation, not Racing, since there is no lap and no finish. Vessel Operation was the closest preset and it is the one modelled on Roblox train places, but its vehicle-deck shape claims the world moves past a walkable deck, and here the player drives roughly 10,000 studs of line through the landscape, and its trigger-task loop was explicitly declined, so with the shape swapped and most options gone I emit no preset rather than a preset that is no longer recognisable. I took route-guided from the catalogue rather than Simulation's typical list: it is one continuous space with a single directed route, which is the answered single point-to-point line, and it routes P0; route-point-to-point was rejected because it is a course with a finish and this has none, and world-open was rejected because the answer chose a line over a roamable field. path-circulation carries the railway corridor with its crossings, path-road-vehicle the roadside road the power lines follow, and npc-population is bent to the moving AI traffic, which has no other home. Decided without a user: free-roam means nothing terminal is placed at either end of the line, and with no station interiors asked for there is no P3.
